sloka: कन्द मूल फलम् हृत्वा को माम् प्रियम् इव अतिथिम् ।भोजयिष्यति अकर्मण्यम् अप्रग्रहम् अनायकम् ॥२-६४-३५॥
transliteration: kanda mūla phalam hṛtvā ko mām priyam iva atithim ।bhojayiṣyati akarmaṇyam apragraham anāyakam ॥2-64-35॥

translations.english: 'I am incapable of doing any work, I am unable to procure anything (to meet my needs. now). I have no guide (to help me walk my way). Who will feed me like a welcome guest with tubers and fruits?
